Trump, and Evans’ fidelity to the president, are recognized as a major albatross here. The president is particularly disliked in Colorado. Civiqs found approval of Trump’s job performance at 31%, with disapproval at 64% on July 30. [...] 1% of the voters we talked to had a favorable impression of the job Trump was doing, while 65% disapproved. For this canvass, we knocked on more unaffiliated than Democratic doors, about 72/28, depending on the walk list.
